source_title: Celebrities Siddharth Anand Posts ‘It’s’ Ahead Of SRK’s Birthday; Is A King Update Coming On Nov 2?
source_excerpt:
Shah Rukh Khan fans may have a reason to watch out for November 2, as filmmaker Siddharth Anand has triggered fresh speculation with a cryptic post on social media. The director shared a one-word tweet, “It, without offering any explanation, prompting fans to wonder whether an update on their upcoming film, King, is on the way. The timing has drawn attention because Anand had teased the superstar’s birthday reveal last year with a message that preceded the film’s first look. With SRK’s birthday approaching, fans are now looking for clues about a possible announcement from the director.
Siddharth Anand recently posted the word “It's” on X, formerly Twitter, without adding any context. The brief message quickly caught the attention of Shah Rukh Khan fans, many of whom are wondering whether it signals a new announcement about King.
The timing has added to the discussion, with the actor’s birthday falling on November 2. However, Anand has not confirmed what the tweet refers to, and there is no official announcement linking it to the film so far.

The speculation comes from Anand’s social media activity last year. Ahead of Shah Rukh Khan’s birthday, the filmmaker posted, “Remember, there is only one king”. The message was followed by the official first-look reveal of King on November 2.
Given that sequence of events, fans are now wondering whether the director is preparing another birthday surprise. His latest post has prompted fresh hopes that the film’s makers could share new details around the same date. For now, though, the possibility remains unconfirmed.
